summary: This re-adoption of PR #618 correctly renumbers the migration to drizzle/0269 to avoid colliding with the already-taken 0268 tag, and the visible parts of the diff show real, non-trivial work: platform-wide schema for prompt_translations/prompt_localizations/prompt_marketplace_listings with FK cascades, veridian_admin-gated permission entries consistent with existing conventions, requireAuth()-gated API routes, and a self-caught RLS bug (an initial SELECT-only policy that would have silently rejected every INSERT/UPDATE from app_runtime despite the table GRANTs allowing it) that gets corrected via a second DROP/CREATE POLICY block later in the same migration file. However, the diff supplied for this review is materially incomplete: three of the four new service files (prompt-translation-service.ts, prompt-localization-service.ts, prompt-marketplace-service.ts) and their colocated *.test.ts files -- the actual LLM-calling business logic, authorization enforcement, and marketplace publish/unlist mutation paths -- are listed in the diffstat but never shown, and even prompt-export-import-service.ts's shown hunk is truncated mid-function before the import insert path completes. I cannot certify architecture, correctness, or security for code I have not been shown, so this cannot be approved as-is regardless of tier2 already requiring human sign-off before merge.
issues: Diff omitted the full source of prompt-translation-service.ts, prompt-localization-service.ts, prompt-marketplace-service.ts, and their *.test.ts files entirely, and truncated prompt-export-import-service.ts mid-function -- re-submit with the complete diff so the LLM-call handling, marketplace publish/unlist authorization, and import-insert logic can actually be reviewed before this is approved.

drizzle/0269_prompt_translation_localization_marketplace.sql bakes a 'first attempt was wrong, here is the correction' narrative directly into one migration file (creates SELECT-only RLS policies + partial grants, then DROPs and recreates them as FOR ALL + adds the missing UPDATE grants later in the same file) instead of just authoring the correct FOR ALL policies once -- functionally converges to a correct end state for a fresh apply, but should be rewritten as a single clean block rather than shipped as a self-correcting diff.
